title: Invest (Remote Rancher)
description: Back a working cattle operation on Paraguay's open pasture from anywhere in the world, with a transparent stake in the herd you help fund.

image.alt: A single black-and-white calf standing in an open grazing pasture, with the rest of the herd scattered across the grassland behind it.

title: Beef
description: Source grass-fed Paraguayan beef with a traceable path from pasture to plate, built for buyers who care where their product comes from.

image.alt: Cattle grazing in an open field, seen from behind, with another animal's head visible in the grass nearby.

title: Land
description: Put idle or underused land to work in a managed grazing partnership, on terrain built for cattle rather than a single crop.

image.alt: A wide, flat grassland under a hazy sky with a large herd of cattle grazing across the open pasture.
